text: Piping classes (materials, ratings, branch tables, corrosion allowances) are defined in the Piping Material Classes ALP-EPC-00000-PI-SPC-0001; welding, heat treatment and NDE in ALP-EPC-00000-PI-SPC-0003; the stress analysis criteria and the critical line list in ALP-EPC-00000-PI-RPT-0001; insulation in ALP-EPC-00000-ME-SPC-0003; painting in ALP-EPC-00000-ME-SPC-0002. This document shall not repeat their values.
